crossRefs.note: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day…
Be careful, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you are going, lest it be for a snare among…
Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart…
Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that Yahweh spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,
Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image…
and said to the judges, “Consider what you do, for you don’t judge for man, but for Yahweh; and he is with you in the…
Now therefore let the fear of Yahweh be on you. Take heed and do it; for there is no iniquity with Yahweh our God, nor…
Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,
looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up…
Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.
“If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have…
Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven…
“ ‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of…
Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse…
Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
Better is open rebuke than hidden love.
But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.
Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,

translations.web: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.
translations.bsb: Watch yourselves. If your brother sins, rebuke him; and if he repents, forgive him.
translations.kjv: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.
translations.asv: Take heed to yourselves: if thy brother sin, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.
